findings.evidence: Interior.lean:43 `theorem ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [ContMDiffMul I n G] (hn : n ≠ 0)`; Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Algebra/Monoid.lean:88,92,102 are the only instances producing `ContMDiffMul I 1 G`; Exponential/Derivative/Basic.lean:47 `[LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℝ 3) G]`.
findings.fix: State `theorem ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold {n : WithTop ℕ∞} [ContMDiffMul I n G] (hn : n ≠ 0) : BoundarylessManifold I G := ⟨ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint hn⟩` and let consumers write `haveI := ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold (n := 3) (by norm_num)` (one line, same as the attribute). If an instance-shaped form is genuinely required, derive it from the general theorem rather than proving only the special case.
findings.issue: Under-generalized: `boundarylessManifold` fixes `n = 1`, while `ContMDiffMul.isInteriorPoint` (line 43) proves the field for every `n ≠ 0` with the identical one-line proof. Mathlib supplies `ContMDiffMul I 1 G` only from `∞` (Monoid.lean:88), `ω` (:92) and `2` (:102) — there is no `3 → 1` chain (contrast `IsManifold` at IsManifold/Basic.lean:866), so a `LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℝ 3) G` consumer (Exponential/Derivative/Basic.lean:47) — the C³ case the PR description names as the motivation — cannot apply `attribute [local instance] ContMDiffMul.boundarylessManifold` without first inserting `ContMDiffMul.of_le`.

findings.evidence: Interior.lean:23-25 vs the `[ContMDiffMul I 1 G]` binder at line 64.
findings.fix: After generalizing per the previous finding the wording is accurate; otherwise say explicitly "with `C^1` multiplication".
findings.issue: The module docstring bullet reads "opt-in proof that such a group manifold is boundaryless", where "such a" refers to the preceding `n ≠ 0` bullet; the theorem actually only covers `n = 1`, overstating its scope.

summary: The packaging theorem is specialized to `n = 1` although the underlying `isInteriorPoint` holds for every `n ≠ 0`, and instance search cannot bridge a general order to order 1 — so the C³ consumers the PR cites cannot use it as stated. State it at the natural generality.
